connectorUiConfig.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Collects audit events and security events from the Salesforce Marketing Cloud [Audit Trail API](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud/references/mc_rest_audit?meta=Summary). Provides visibility into user activities, system changes, and login events.

sampleQueries.description: All Audit Events - sorted by time

sampleQueries.query:
SalesforceMarketingCloudAuditEvents
| summarize count() by OperationName
| sort by count_ desc

sampleQueries.description: All Security Events - sorted by time

sampleQueries.query:
SalesforceMarketingCloudSecurityEvents
| where LoginStatusName != "Successful"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: SalesforceMarketingCloudAuditEvents
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SalesforceMarketingCloudAuditEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: SalesforceMarketingCloudSecurityEvents
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SalesforceMarketingCloudSecurityEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Connect Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Follow the [Salesforce Marketing Cloud documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud/guide/install-packages.html) to create an Installed Package with the **Data | Tracking Event | Read** permission scope. Note your tenant-specific REST API and Auth base URLs from the Installed Packages section in Setup.

instructionSteps.title: Manage Salesforce Connections
instructionSteps.description: Add, view, and delete Salesforce connections

parameters.label: Add Connection
parameters.title: Configure API Connection
parameters.subtitle: Connect to Salesforce to ingest data

parameters.text: Enter a unique alias to identify this Salesforce connection. **Important**: Use different aliases for each domain. To update an existing connection, use the same alias or delete and create with the same alias. To replace a connection, delete the old one and create a new one with a new alias.
Enter your tenant-specific REST API Base URL without trailing slash (Example, https://{subdomain}.rest.marketingcloudapis.com). Find it in the Installed Packages section in Setup.
Include your subdomain in the Auth Base URL. This is different from your REST API Base URL.

options.text: Audit Events - user activities and system changes
Security Events - login attempts and authentication

instructionSteps.title: API Credentials
instructionSteps.description: Configure Installed Package credentials for API access

parameters.text: Select the type of Installed Package you created in Marketing Cloud. **Enhanced Package** uses the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow against the `/v2/token` endpoint. **Legacy Package** uses the `/v1/requestToken` endpoint. Both require the Consumer Key (Client Id) and Consumer Secret from your Installed Package.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Salesforce Marketing Cloud solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests audit and security events from the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Audit Trail API through the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). It provides visibility into user activity, system changes, login attempts, and authentication outcomes. For API details, see https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/marketing/marketing-cloud/references/mc_rest_audit?meta=Summary.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Azure Monitor Logs
  • Data Collection Rules (DCR)
  • Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

Dependencies:

  • A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Installed Package
  • Data Tracking Event Read permission
  • Tenant-specific REST and authentication base URLs

Data Connectors: 1, Parsers: 2
